User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user account in the e-commerce application.

id.description: The unique identifier for the user, matching their Firebase Auth UID.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the user account was created.

photoUrl.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

address.description: The user's shipping or billing address.

isAdmin.description: Flag indicating if the user has administrative privileges.

businessName.description: The name of the user's business.

showLabourCharges.description: Setting to show/hide labour charges on bills.

showTransportCharges.description: Setting to show/hide transport charges on bills.

labourRate.description: The rate charged for labour per square foot.

sheets.description: The user's saved granite measurement sheets.

activeSheetId.description: The ID of the currently active sheet.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product available for sale in the store.

id.description: The unique identifier for the product.

description.description: A detailed description of the product.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the product was created.

category.description: The category the product belongs to.

stockQuantity.description: The available quantity of the product in stock.

CartItem.title: CartItem
CartItem.description: Represents an item within a user's shopping cart.

id.description: The unique identifier for the cart item.

quantity.description: The quantity of the product in the cart.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the item was added to the cart.

id.description: The unique identifier for the order.

orderDate.description: The timestamp when the order was placed.

totalAmount.description: The total amount of the order.

status.description: The current status of the order (e.g., 'pending', 'shipped', 'delivered').

shippingAddress.description: The address where the order will be shipped.

OrderItem.title: OrderItem
OrderItem.description: Represents a single item within an order.

id.description: The unique identifier for the order item.

quantity.description: The quantity of the product ordered.

unitPrice.description: The price of a single unit of the product at the time of order.

definition.description: Stores public user profile information. The document ID is the same as the Firebase Auth UID.
Top-level collection for all products available in the store.
A subcollection under a user document storing items in their shopping cart. This ensures a user can only access their own cart.
A subcollection under a user document storing their order history. This ensures a user can only see their own orders.
A subcollection under an order document listing the specific products in that order.
